title: Irish Seafood Stew
description: A hearty, warming stew filled with Irish ingredients and a variety of seafood.

ingredients.name: Irish Sausages
ingredients.notes: You can also use Irish bacon or ham.

ingredients.name: New Potatoes
ingredients.notes: You can peel them if you prefer.

ingredients.name: Carrots
ingredients.notes: You can peel them if you prefer.

ingredients.name: Onions
ingredients.notes: You can use red or yellow onions.

ingredients.name: Crab Meat
ingredients.notes: You can use fresh or canned crab meat.

ingredients.name: Shrimp
ingredients.notes: You can use frozen or fresh shrimp.

ingredients.name: Mussels
ingredients.notes: You can use fresh or frozen mussels.

ingredients.name: Seafood Broth
ingredients.notes: You can use store-bought broth or make your own.

instructions: Melt the butter in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onions and garlic and cook until softened.
Add the Irish sausages and cook until browned.
Add the potatoes, carrots, and seafood broth.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the crab meat, shrimp, and mussels.
Simmer for an additional 5 minutes, until the seafood is cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
